question: Which of these is NOT one of the common goals of five-year plans?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Globalisation.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• The **five-year plans** were introduced in India in **1951** to accelerate the pace of** economic growth and development.**
 
• **Self-reliance, modernization, growth, and equity** are the four common goals of five-year plans.
 
• Self-reliance aims to **reduce dependence **on foreign aid and promote domestic resources.
 
• Modernization aims to promote** industrialization, technological advancement,** and **infrastructure development**.
 
• Growth aims to increase the **national income **and improve the **living standards **of the people.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Globalization** refers to the integration of **economies, cultures, and societies **across the world.
 
• It is not a common goal of **five-year plans** as it emerged as a concept in the **1990s.**
 
• **Self-reliance** is an important concept that has been emphasized in India's** economic policies** since independence.
 
 
• It aims to promote indigenous** industries, reduce imports, and encourage exports.**
 
 
 
• **Modernization** is critical for achieving **sustainable economic growth** and **development**.
 
 
• It includes the adoption of new **technologies,** **modernizing infrastructure**, and improving the **quality of education** and healthcare.
 
 
 
• **Growth **is an essential goal of **economic development** as it helps to reduce **poverty, unemployment, and inequality**.
 
 
• However, growth must be **inclusive and sustainable** to benefit all sections of society.
